en.why: The collapse, the flip and the burst all use the same 15 cards, so the viewer recognizes them the whole time and the cut from interface to collage needs no mask or cross-fade. The gap between page turns shrinks from 0.20s to 0.07s, and the last six pages are in the air together and stop as a fan that the burst starts from. The burst uses expo.out and is followed by 4s of linear drift, so the frame never stops. Depth-of-field blur separates near and far cards, and vermilion is the only accent color against neutrals.
spec: Film 10.5s. Interface 0–1.62s, camera pushes from z 0 to z 70 over 0–1.9s (power1.out), cursor travels to the button 0.45–1.6s, click at 1.62s; cards collapse into a book 1.62–2.9s (1.15s); window recedes and fades over 0.8s (24 frames); page flips 2.6–4.78s (15 pages; the first 9 take 0.64s shrinking to 0.51s each with the gap shrinking from 0.20s to 0.07s; the last 6 take 0.94s shrinking to 0.56s and all stop in a fan at 4.78s); fan holds 4.78–4.95s, anticipation 4.85–4.95s (0.1s, 3 frames); burst 4.95–6.3s (1.35s); drift 6.2–10.5s; veil rises from 7.7s over 0.9s, wordmark 8.0–9.1s, tagline from 8.4s over 0.7s

Collapse and burst cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) (expo.out); first 9 page flips power2.inOut, last 6 a front-loaded ease that starts fast and settles into the fan (0.7 × out power 1.6 + 0.3 × inOut power 1.6); window recede power2.in; camera orbit power3.inOut; camera pan power2.inOut; opening push power1.out; post-burst drift and slow camera push linear; wordmark expo.out

Perspective 1600px. From 0–1.9s the camera pushes from z 0 to z 70 (power1.out). From 1.9–3.4s it turns to rotY −26°, rotX 8° and pushes to z 150; the view also pans 211px left to center the closed book (1.62–2.52s) and pans back to 0 as the pages open (2.7–3.6s); during the flips rotY turns at constant speed from −26° to +20° (3.4–4.95s) while z pushes slowly from 150 to 260 (3.4–4.85s), backing to z 200 at the anticipation; at the burst the camera returns to rotY −4°, z 150 (expo.out, 1.5s), then pushes slowly for about 4s to z 330, rotY 5°

15 cards of 240×320, each with a front and a back showing another card's content; each card has a cream paper edge on its right and bottom sides as thick as the page spacing (two creams alternating) and a 46px dark gradient at the spine side (opacity 0.36), so the closed book shows its thickness; scale 0.76 in the interface, 1.6 as the book (384×512, page spacing 3.6px, book about 50px thick), 0.8–1.1 in the collage; pages turn about the spine (x 960): the first 9 to −180°, the last 6 stop at −168°, −146°, −124°, −102°, −80° and −58° as a fan; at the burst each card keeps turning another 160°–320° and lands within ±25° of face-on between z −330 and +340, with 8 extra shapes (4 discs, 2 rounded squares, 1 dotted ring, 1 thin outline ring) between z −420 and +380; card depth-of-field blur up to about 4px, plus a 0.12s 3px motion blur that starts on all 15 cards together at the burst, ignoring the stagger; during the 0.1s anticipation the first 9 pages fan apart in z, page spacing from 3.6px to 9px (the last 6 are already 9px apart while flipping)

Click at 1.62s: the button press and the card launch are on the same frame; the last 6 pages stop in the fan at 4.78s, hold for 0.17s, and the burst starts from the fan at 4.95s; cards are staggered 0–0.16s at the burst and the shapes start 0.05–0.16s after it; the collage keeps drifting while the veil rises; the dark quote card lands in the upper left of the collage, fully inside the frame and clear of the wordmark area

Light theme. Warm gray desktop #dcd7ce → #cfc9bf, neutrals #1b1a18, #8d877e, #cfc8bb, #e9e4da, vermilion accent #ff5a36; interface in Inter, serif for the type-specimen card, Archivo Black for the poster card; grain and vignette on top

Use one accent color, vermilion #ff5a36, and neutrals (#1b1a18, #8d877e, #cfc8bb, #e9e4da) on a warm gray desktop. Use HTML + CSS 3D (perspective 1600px) and GSAP. Prepare 15 cards of 240×320 (photo poster, color palette, type specimen, phone screenshot, quote, product shot, article link, sticky note, texture, typographic poster, chart, architecture illustration, materials, record sleeve, component kit), each with a front and a back; give each card a cream paper edge on its right and bottom sides as thick as the page spacing, and a 46px dark gradient at the spine side (opacity 0.36). 0–1.62s: a 1700×960 macOS-style window with a sidebar, top bar, a 5×3 card grid (cards scaled 0.76) and a details panel on the right; the camera pushes in slowly from z 0 to z 70 over 0–1.9s (power1.out); the cursor travels to the Present button over 0.45–1.6s. Page flips 2.6–4.78s: each page turns about the spine (the first 9 with power2.inOut, the last 6 with a front-loaded ease that starts fast and settles into the fan: 0.7 × out power 1.6 + 0.3 × inOut power 1.6), with the gap between flips shrinking from 0.20s to 0.07s; the first 9 pages turn to −180°, each 0.64s shrinking to 0.51s; the last 6 pages take 0.94s shrinking to 0.56s and all end at 4.78s as a fan at −168°, −146°, −124°, −102°, −80° and −58°, so six pages are in the air together; add a shade on a page while it turns; camera rotY turns at constant speed from −26° to +20° (3.4–4.95s) while z pushes slowly from 150 to 260 (3.4–4.85s, power1.in). The fan holds for 0.17s; anticipation 4.85–4.95s: cards scale to 0.93, the first 9 pages fan apart in z to 9px spacing (the last 6 already are) and the camera backs to z 200. Burst at 4.95s from the fan: the 15 cards fly with expo.out over 1.35s to 3D positions between z −330 and +340, staggered 0–0.16s, each card turning another 160°–320° and ending within ±25° of face-on at scale 0.8–1.1; 8 shapes (4 discs, 2 rounded squares, 1 dotted ring, 1 thin outline ring) start 0.05–0.16s later and fly with expo.out over 1.3s to z −420 to +380; the camera returns to rotY −4°, z 150 over 1.5s with expo.out. Add a 3px blur for 0.12s starting on all cards together at the burst, then depth-of-field blur by distance (up to about 4px). Place the dark quote card in the upper left of the collage, fully inside the frame and clear of the wordmark area. en.title: Flipbook Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A moodboard collapses into a book, flips page by page, then bursts into a 3D collage drifting toward the camera. Make it with Claude Code or Codex.
en.lede: After a click, the 15 cards on a moodboard collapse into a book, the pages flip faster and faster, then burst into a 3D collage that drifts toward the camera and settles behind a wordmark.
en.name: Flipbook Animation

body.h2: How to make a Flipbook Animation with Claude Code or Codex
body.body:
Prepare 15 cards of 240×320, each with a front, a back and a paper edge as thick as the page spacing, and place them in a 5×3 grid inside an app window at scale 0.76. On the click (1.62s) collapse them with expo.out over 1.15s into a closed book at screen center, scale 1.6, page spacing 3.6px, spine at x 960, while the window recedes to z −320 over 0.8s and the view pans 211px left to center the closed book.

Flip the pages from 2.6s to 4.78s: each page turns about the spine with power2.inOut, the gap between flips shrinks from 0.20s to 0.07s, and the last six pages stop in a fan between −168° and −58° so they are in the air together. Turn the camera from rotY −26° to +20° at constant speed under perspective 1600px, hold the fan for 0.17s, then shrink the cards to 0.93 times their book size over the last 0.1s while the camera backs to z 200.

At 4.95s send the 15 cards to z −330 to +340 and 8 shapes (4 discs, 2 rounded squares, a dotted ring and a thin outline ring) to z −420 to +380 with expo.out over about 1.3s, each card turning on to face-on, then drift the cards 40–170px toward the camera until 10.5s with depth-of-field blur up to about 4px. Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard. Render an MP4 with HyperFrames, or port the GSAP timeline to your website.

en.alt: A fan of design cards flipping like pages: a colour palette, a chart with +34% and an arched illustration.
faq: What is a flipbook animation in a product video?

It turns a set of screens or images into pages of a book that flip one after another. In this film the cards from a moodboard become the pages, so the transition shows the same content before, during and after the flip.
How does the film go from a flat interface to a 3D collage?
All 15 cards are 3D elements from the first frame. At the click they leave the grid, form the book, flip and then fly to scattered depths between z −330 and +340, so no mask or cross-fade is needed.

Yes. Motionboard is free and MIT licensed, so you can use and modify the recipes and the films they produce in personal and commercial projects. The licence asks only that copies of the recipe files keep the copyright notice.

zh.title: 翻页动画：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 白板里的卡片收成一本书，越翻越快，再炸开成朝镜头漂来的 3D 拼贴。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个翻页动画效果。
zh.lede: 点击按钮后，白板里的 15 张卡片收成一本书，逐页翻动并越翻越快，然后全部炸开成一幅朝镜头漂来的 3D 拼贴，最后落在字标上。
zh.name: 翻页动画效果

body.h2: 用 Claude Code 或 Codex 做翻页动画效果
body.body:
准备 15 张 240×320 的卡片，每张有正反面和一条与页间距等厚的纸边，按 5×3 放进 App 窗口，缩放 0.76。点击时（1.62s）用 expo.out 1.15s 把它们收成屏幕中央合上的一本书，缩放 1.6，页间距 3.6px，书脊在 x 960，窗口同时用 0.8s 退到 z −320，画面向左平移 211px 让合上的书居中。

2.6s 到 4.78s 翻页：每页以书脊为轴转动，缓动 power2.inOut，页间隔从 0.20s 缩到 0.07s，最后 6 页停成 −168° 到 −58° 的扇形，所以它们同时在空中。透视 1600px 下相机 rotY 从 −26° 匀速转到 +20°，扇形停住 0.17s，最后 0.1s 书堆缩到 0.93 倍，相机退到 z 200。

4.95s 用 expo.out 把 15 张卡片炸到 z −330 到 +340，8 个形状（4 个圆、2 个圆角方块、1 个点线圆环、1 个细线圆环）炸到 z −420 到 +380，用时约 1.3s，每张卡片继续转到正面朝前，然后卡片在 10.5s 前朝镜头漂 40–170px，景深模糊最大约 4px。点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill。可以用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4，也可以把 GSAP 时间线移植到网站上。

zh.alt: 一叠设计卡片像书页一样翻开：配色卡、标着 +34% 的图表和拱门插画。
faq: 产品视频里的翻页动画是什么？
把一组界面或图片做成书页，一页接一页翻过去。这支片子里白板的卡片就是书页，所以翻页前、翻页中和翻页后看到的是同一批内容。
片子怎么从平面界面变成 3D 拼贴？
15 张卡片从第一帧起就是 3D 元素。点击后它们离开网格，收成书，翻页，再飞到 z −330 到 +340 的不同深度，不需要遮罩或叠化。
可以。Motionboard 免费，使用 MIT 许可证，你可以在个人和商业项目里使用、修改配方和它生成的视频。许可证只要求复制配方文件时保留版权声明。
